DefinitionType.description: The abstract base type for all schema definitions. It provides common metadata such as descriptions and deprecation status.

description.description: A brief explanation of the purpose and usage of this definition.

type.description: The discriminator value used to identify the specific definition type.

deprecated.description: Indicates whether this type is deprecated and should not be used in new implementations.

StructDefinitionType.description: Represents an object with a fixed set of properties (such as a class or record). Supports inheritance and explicit property typing.

parent.description: A reference to another struct definition from which this struct inherits properties.

base.description: When set to true, marks this struct as an abstract base type that cannot be instantiated directly.

properties.description: A map of property names to their respective schema definitions.

discriminator.description: The property name used to determine the concrete subclass during deserialization.

mapping.description: Maps discriminator field values to their corresponding definition names to support polymorphism.

CollectionDefinitionType.description: The abstract base type for collection definitions that contain multiple elements of a uniform type.

schema.description: The schema definition for the elements or values contained in this collection.

MapDefinitionType.description: Represents a key-value map with dynamic key names where all values conform to the same schema.

ArrayDefinitionType.description: Represents an ordered list of elements where every item conforms to the same schema.

PropertyType.description: The abstract base type for all property definitions within a struct or collection.

description.description: Documentation explaining the purpose and usage of this property.

type.description: The discriminator value used to identify the specific property type.

deprecated.description: Indicates whether this property is deprecated and should no longer be used.

nullable.description: Indicates whether this property accepts a null value.

ScalarPropertyType.description: The abstract base type for simple scalar value properties (strings, integers, numbers, booleans).

StringPropertyType.description: Represents a sequence of characters, with optional formatting rules.

format.description: Specifies a semantic format or hint for the string value (e.g., 'date-time', 'email', 'uri').

default.description: The default string value to use if the property is omitted.

IntegerPropertyType.description: Represents a whole number without fractional components.

NumberPropertyType.description: Represents a numeric value, including floating-point and decimal numbers.

BooleanPropertyType.description: Represents a boolean true or false value.

CollectionPropertyType.description: The abstract base type for properties that define inline collections (maps or arrays).

schema.description: The schema definition for the items contained within this collection property.

MapPropertyType.description: Represents a property containing a key-value map where all values share the same schema.

ArrayPropertyType.description: Represents a property containing a list of items that share the same schema.

AnyPropertyType.description: Represents a wildcard property that accepts any valid JSON value (object, array, string, number, boolean, or null).

GenericPropertyType.description: Represents a generic placeholder type that is resolved at runtime or via template arguments.

name.description: The generic parameter name (e.g., 'T'), which is bound via the template map in a reference.

ReferencePropertyType.description: Represents a reference to a type defined in the global definitions dictionary.

target.description: The key of the target definition in the definitions map.

template.description: Binds generic parameter names in the target definition to concrete definition names.

TypeSchema.description: The root document object containing namespace imports, type definitions, and the root entry point.

import.description: Maps namespace aliases to external TypeSchema document locations.

definitions.description: A dictionary mapping definition names to their respective schema definitions.

root.description: The name of the primary entry-point definition for this schema.
